integrity: All-order proof by an explicit path-connected star-intersection cover and van Kampen; finite signed orbit-chain Smith computations independently check ten boundary instances; no claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only geometric diagonal color-rotation quotients of clique-path independence complexes; classifies fundamental groups and first integral homology, not higher invariants or nonfree actions; unindexed equivalent prior work remains possible.
title: Sharp fundamental groups of cyclic color quotients of clique-path independence complexes
